title: Expose structured validation diagnostics
scope: Define and implement diagnostics with stable rule IDs, object context and thread-safe delivery.
acceptance: External consumers receive machine-readable IDs and relevant arguments without parsing stderr.
Reentrancy, callback lifetime and OOM behavior are documented and tested.
evidence: PASS: ctest --test-dir build-d3d12-baseline -C Release --output-on-failure -R parallel-mater-(generated-api-check|reject-layer|loader-validation|layer-|manual-layer); 10/10 on Windows/MSVC 19.51 after merging origin/main; tests/api/layer_validation_tests.cpp covers copied callback lifetime, reentrancy, concurrent delivery and deterministic OOM.

PASS: relocated installed SDK external build and ctest -C Release --output-on-failure; 4/4 on Windows/MSVC 19.51; tests/sdk/diagnostics.c verifies PM-VAL-0002, application device context and registry-generated typed arguments without stderr parsing.
